title: Chapter 312: Collective Promotion Of Senior Generals
content:
Chapter 312: Collective Promotion Of Senior Generals

When everyone heard Wang Shuo's question, they didn't dare to refute for a while.

If they were accused of such a crime at this time, what if Hedong County defeated the undead and settled accounts later? Wouldn't they suffer an undeserved disaster?

"Let's not talk about the appointment of Hedong County for now, just look at the undead confrontation list. Whoever is first will be the acting county magistrate. You won't have any objections, right?!"

Wang Shuo's tone was grim and he didn't allow any objection.

On the undead confrontation list, Wang Shuo of Wana Town firmly occupied the first place by destroying 32 altars of different sizes, killing 1 undead warrior and 109 undead generals.

At the beginning, only the destruction of altars was used as the basis for ranking, but as the first warrior was killed, the killing of undead generals was also included in the statistical scope.

The second place was Zheng Zhongji of Qinghe Town. He destroyed 13 altars and killed 47 undead generals.

After everyone checked the list, they finally shut up.

Because he was the only one who had a record of killing a general.

Even Zheng Zhongji and Bu Lanlan were puzzled. When did this guy kill a general?

"Okay, since everyone has no objection, then this matter is settled."

"Those who are unwilling to participate in the reinforcement of Hedong County can leave Changping County. I will never stop them."

"Those who are willing to stay and participate in this decisive battle, I hope you can cooperate and act in unison."

"Yes, County Magistrate."

...

Next, Wang Shuo opened the teleportation array between Changping County and Wana Town, teleported his confidants over, and took over Changping County.

When cleaning the treasury, Wang Shuo got a large number of military generals' job transfer certificates and tiger talismans.

One of the intermediate tiger talismans made Wang Shuo happy.

[Intermediate tiger talisman: the carrier's command value +5000. ]

In this way, Wang Shuo can directly command an army of 50,000 people.

There are also various supplies and equipment, but the number is not large. They should have been consumed in the previous defensive battle.

Wang Shuo counted his assets. Currently, he has 12 million energy crystals and 80,000 soul crystals.

During this period, he had made a lot of money through trade and killing undead skeletons. In addition, the treasury of Changping County had such a rich property, which was within Wang Shuo's expectations.

Seeing the military officer transfer certificate in his hand, Wang Shuo immediately called Gong Zheng and others in.

There were 10 primary, 5 intermediate, and 5 advanced.

Wang Shuo handed Li Jianguo a senior military officer transfer certificate, but found that he could not use it directly. The system prompted him that he needed a mid-level military officer transfer certificate.

It seems that there is no way to take advantage of the loophole.

Wang Shuo had to honestly upgrade the military officer levels of his subordinates one by one.

Ye Tianba, Gong Zheng, Gong Ping, Gong Kai, and Li Jianguo were the candidates for using senior military officers this time.

In this way, including Wang Shuo, Good, and Ayub.

Wana Town has 8 senior military officers.

After returning to Wana Town, Wang Shuo engraved the names of several people on the generals' platform, which could further improve the attributes of these high-level generals.

Recalling what Xie Xiaofeng said before leaving, Wang Shuo should integrate the forces of Changping County as soon as possible, but he did not give him a specific time.

Wang Shuo estimated that it would only take one or two days. If a war broke out, he would probably be asked to set off immediately.

Therefore, while there was still some time, he had to deal with the miscellaneous matters as soon as possible, and then integrate the army and go to Haihe City, the capital of Hedong County.
